ns2:section.sectionText: Online & Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu The course will be taught via Collaborate v.12 and Compass 2G. Students will need a a web cam, working external microphone/speakers or headset with microphone and reliable high-speed Internet. Access to scanner capable of producing .pdf files may be required for exam. This course is not available to students who completed FSHN 595 ?Nutrition for Health & Fitness? during summer 2012.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MS: FSHN (Online) -UIUC or MS:FSci &Hmn Nutrition -UIUC.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $387.00 per Bill Hour, Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $353.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
